chunks: Saad ibn Abdullah narrated from Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Ubaid from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman from al-Husayn ibn Thuwayr ibn Abi Fakhtah from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

The Imamate will not return to two brothers after Hasan and Husayn (peace be upon them), and after Ali ibn Husayn (peace be upon him) it will be only in the descendants, and the descendants of the descendants.
ai.seo_question: What is the rule regarding the succession of Imamate after Hasan and Husayn?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* clarifies the specific lineage of the Imamate following the era of Hasan and Husayn, refuting the Kaisaniyya belief that Imamate could alternate between brothers. It establishes that after Ali ibn Husayn (Zayn al-Abidin), the Imamate remains strictly within his direct male descendants (A'qab), ensuring a continuous, unbroken line of succession through the progeny of Husayn.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 160 - Saad bin Abdullah has narrated from Muhammad bin Isa bin Ubaid from Yunus bin Abdur Rahman from Husain bin Thuwair bin Abi Fakhta from Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s) that he said:
After Hasan and Husain, Imamate will never come to two brothers because after Ali Ibn Husain, Imamate is only in his progeny, generation after generation.
